name: encore
title: Encore
description: A band and artist theme built around the tour-dates list — a date block, the city in heavy capitals, a ticket button on the right and a magenta strike through every sold-out show — in stage-light magenta on warm near-black, with a real daylight scheme.

tokens.--font-display: the band name, page titles, city names and the big day numeral (heavy, tight, in capitals)
tokens.--font-mono: weekdays and months, status stamps, small labels
tokens.--text-s: small print: menu, labels, stamps, button text, footer
tokens.--text-l: intro lines, section headings, the band name in the header
tokens.--text-xl: city names and day numerals in the tour list
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of headings and city names
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capital labels (wide)
tokens.--tracking-display: letter spacing of the big display type (tight)
tokens.--weight-display: how heavy the display type and button text are
tokens.--color-bg: page background: warm paper in daylight, warm near-black on stage (dark scheme)
tokens.--color-text: main text: warm near-black in daylight, warm white on stage
tokens.--color-muted: house lights: quieter text for venues, months, intro lines and played shows
tokens.--color-accent: stage light: the magenta of ticket buttons, the sold-out strike and stamp, links and the current menu item
tokens.--color-border: thin rules between shows and around the header and footer
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a text column
tokens.--date-col: width of the date column in the tour list (section headings hang in it on text pages)
tokens.--action-col: width of the ticket button and status stamps on wide screens
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale: roomy (the air between shows)
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of buttons, stamps, images and code
tokens.--radius-pill: rounding of small status chips (fully round)
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the sold-out strike, the current-menu bar and the quote rule
tokens.--tap-target: minimum height of buttons, stamps and menu links
